QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Training to Conquer
QuestInfo.0: The master is about to speak on the Wu Tien Mountain conquest training. Go and listen with your brothers.
QuestInfo.1: Nobody wanted to head to Wu Tien Mountain! But the master... encouraged them, and off they went. The senior brother will meet you at the entrance.\r\n[Transportation: Take the portal in the Drill Hall to the Training Grounds, and select Wu Tien Mountain]
QuestInfo.2: You've conquered Wu Tien Mountain, a full 2,300 meters above sea level. Now, back to your training! Get permission from the senior brother at the entrance of Wu Tien Mountain. There will surely be rewards for taking on the challenge multiple times, too.

default.0: I wish you well in your journey. The Wu Tien Mountain Entrance can be reached through the portal at the right end of the Drill Hall.
